items.Sentence: The headworks include a rotary hydroscreen system, a screenings washer, and a metering flume.
Terminal Lift Station ... has two submersible pumps, one 5 horsepower (HP) and one 10HP.
Intermediate Lift Station has two 23HP high speed/high head pumps and pumps wastewater through 6,099 feet of 6-inch DI force main under Covey Road to the gravity sewer main at Van Keppel Road.

The pond has a volumetric capacity of 2.93 million gallons, and is divided into three baffled cells ... the first cell contains two 7.5-horsepower aerators ... the third cell contains a 3-horsepower aerator, set on a timer, to create aerobic and anoxic conditions within the pond.
The settling pond (also known as the North Pond) is used for storage during high flows and for filter backwashes.
Tertiary treatment is achieved in the microfiltration system.
Sodium hypochlorite is stored in a 540-gallon tank and is conveyed to the injection point through a 1-inch line by a pair of peristaltic pumps.
Sodium hypochlorite is injected into the 8-inch influent line prior to entering the chlorine contact tank ... the chlorinated effluent is dechlorinated using sodium bisulfite.

Treated wastewater is discharged to an approximately 3.25-million-gallon effluent storage pond used for storage of advanced treated wastewater prior to discharge to Jones Creek or the recycled water system.
Biosolids generated during the treatment process accumulate in the aeration and settling ponds, where they undergo anaerobic digestion and densification.
The cleaned and dewatered solids are disposed of at a landfill.
The cleaned and dewatered solids are disposed of at a landfill.
During the 2012 biosolids removal event, approximately 99 dry tons of solids were removed from the ponds and land applied by Synagro Technologies, Inc.
A chlorine gas system was replaced with a sodium hypochlorite system in May 2014.
